entities.name: Query adenylate kinase
observations: The 218-residue sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt adenylate kinase C1D6J0 from Laribacter hongkongensis.
The sequence contains Pfam ADK domain PF00406.30 at residues 5–185 and ADK_lid PF05191.21 at residues 123–158.
The corresponding enzyme annotation is adenylate kinase, EC 2.7.4.3, with AMP kinase activity and ATP binding.

entities.name: AMP + ATP ⇌ 2 ADP
observations: Adenylate kinase catalyzes reversible transfer of the terminal phosphate of ATP to AMP, producing two ADP molecules.
The reaction is recorded as Rhea RHEA:12973 and EC 2.7.4.3.

entities.name: Adenylate kinase sequence properties
observations: The query protein is 218 amino acids long with calculated molecular mass 23,174 Da and theoretical pI 5.67.
